ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and flag the driver account for abuse of the "I'm Here" / waiting-fee button (NS-2); no legitimate no-show fee was ever earned (RD-6 not triggered — driver's prior upheld dispute was a no-show, not a route dispute).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: I read every chat message [F8, F9, F10], the complaint and the driver's statement [F12]. Nothing is a threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the dispute type is a fee dispute (no-show), not safety. safety_concern = none.

NS-0 routing: cancelled_by = driver [F3], and the driver asserts rider no-show [F10, F12] → NS-1 / NS-2 apply.

NS-1 as driver-cancels-for-no-show requires all three: (i) "I'm Here" tapped (or platform auto-arrival); (ii) GPS at the pickup point at the tap; (iii) >3 min of continuous waiting within range afterwards.
- (i) is satisfied: driver tapped "I'm Here" at 12:06:15 [F5]. Note the record shows a driver tap, not a platform auto-arrival; driver_arrived_at is null [F4], so no platform arrival confirmation exists either.
- (ii) fails: at the tap the driver was 600 m from the pickup point [F5], and his closest approach in the whole trip was 599 m at 12:06:55 [F1] — never within the 200 m arrival radius.
- (iii) fails: he stayed within 200 m for 0 s after the tap [F5]; he was stationary 600 m away from 12:05:55 to 12:09:25 [F2].
Two of the three conditions are not met, and the GPS record (system data) overrides the driver's statement "I pressed I'm Here and waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup" [F12]. Even the cancellation itself, only 3 min 30 s after he became stationary and 3 min 10 s after the tap, does not match the stated 3+ min wait at the correct location.

NS-2 consequence: since NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) are not all satisfied, the $6.61 cancellation fee must be refunded in full → refund_full of $6.61 [F6]. In addition, because the driver tapped "I'm Here" while GPS placed him outside the pickup radius (600 m > 200 m) [F5], the case carries flag_account (misuse of the arrival/waiting button per NS-2). The rider's complaint [F9: "I'm at the pickup point, no car here"] is corroborated by the GPS record [F1, F2].

Supporting/irrelevant facts: traffic shows only a mid-band speed reading on Jalan Besar (band 3, 20–29 km/h) [F13] and no incidents [F14]; neither supplies a reasonable cause for the no-show, and RD-4 is not in issue here. Weather fair [F15]. Profile facts [F16, F17] do not decide the case; RD-6 is not triggered because the driver's one prior upheld dispute is a no-show, not a route deviation.

Evidence status: sufficient — GPS approach/stationary traces, the full timestamped "I'm Here" record, the cancellation timeline and the fare line settle every element; evidence_gap = null. Rider claim that the driver was never at the pickup point is upheld (rejected_claims: driver's F12 account of waiting at the pickup and the no-show assertion in F10).

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he pressed 'I'm Here' and waited >3 minutes at the pickup point is contradicted by the GPS record: at the tap (12:06:15) he was 600 m away [F5], his closest approach all trip was 599 m [F1], and the platform never recorded him at the pickup (driver_arrived_at null) [F4]. System records override statements.
Driver's chat assertion that the rider's 3 minutes had elapsed as a no-show has no basis: the waiting must occur within the pickup radius, and he stayed within 200 m for 0 s [F5].
